'''Ordnance disposal''' was a unit of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. It was composed of [[bomb disposal expert]]s who were responsible for detecting, securing, and disposing of explosives.

==History==
[[File:Ordonance_disposal_droid.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An ordnance disposal [[Droid/Legends|droid]] alongside a [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], several bomb disposal officers were present at the [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege]]. They secured the bombs that had been used to hold several hostages after the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] were neutralized by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]]. One of the [[Unidentified explosives disposal officer|explosives officers]] discovered that the bombs had actually been fakes.
